claims.text: Antidote for inhalation inj w ↑sus of cyanide poisoning
claims.quote: One antidote, hydroxocobalamin, may be given in patients with high suspicion of cyanide poisoning.

claims.text: If cyanide poisoning = strongly sus, consultation should ⍉delay hydroxocobalamin
claims.quote: However, if cyanide poisoning is strongly suspected, consultation should not delay the administration of hydroxocobalamin.
